Piixpal 0.4.0 — https://github.com/diiviikk5/Piixpal

Unmodified `dist/core.min.js` and `dist/c/roomba.min.js`, downloaded from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/piixpal@0.4.0/ and served locally.
The original MIT license is included in LICENSE.

Only Roomba is registered; FooterRoomba.astro supplies the site integration,
keyboard support, lifecycle cleanup, and reduced-motion handling.
